features.name: semantic_routine_access_score
features.description: Assessor assigns a numeric score from 0.0 to 1.0 using only the row codes and fixed training-fold frequency context: 0.0 indicates an unusual or weakly supported request pattern, while 1.0 indicates a routine, internally coherent request pattern.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a soft ordinal axis capturing cross-field coherence that exact top-code formulas may not fully represent.

features.name: semantic_role_specificity_score
features.description: Assessor assigns a numeric score from 0.0 to 1.0 from rollup, department, title, family description, family, and code context: 0.0 indicates broad or generic role scope, while 1.0 indicates narrow or specialized role scope.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous scope measure that can be combined through linear weights with commonness and pair-alignment scores.
